tokens.name: blood
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Big blocks of colour: hero sections, campaign posts, the recommended price card, primary icon. Text on blood is white (small) or black (headlines 24px and up).

tokens.name: blood-bright
tokens.usage: Blood lifted for use ON BLACK only: italic accents, numbers, thin lines and links on black. Never on white or pink.

tokens.name: blood-text
tokens.usage: Red text on white at any size (4.8:1). On pink, only 24px and up.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on white and pink; black sections, footers and Erotic Ritual Art. Black headlines on blood from 24px up.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground for reading sections; text and buttons on blood and black.

tokens.name: flesh
tokens.usage: The soft relief colour: quote panels, photo grounds, price-card highlights. Text on flesh is black.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Neutral background behind content boards and form fields. Never a section colour on the live site.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text and hairlines on white; hairlines on black.

tokens.name: paper-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on black (14px and up).

styles.name: display-l

styles.name: body

styles.usage: Card details and small print. Never smaller.

styles.name: label

styles.name: label-s
